params.message:
Remove the review hand: Elixir no longer writes a grant for Vera

Vera, the review product, is gone. Elixir wrote its grant (#agent-vera,
review.publish|invite|sign on vera/<project>/*) whenever
ELIXIR_CONTROL_VERA_KEY was set; that key left elixir's crontab on
5 October, so the gateway has not served the hand since. This removes the
code path so the grant cannot come back by setting a variable.

- App\Control\ReviewHand and its call in ControlService are removed, with
  the control_vera_key setting.
- PolicyLog no longer names #agent-vera or describes vera/ resources; a
  hand it does not name is still said by its DID URL.
- Tests: the review hand's two tests go; the policy-log tests that used
  review.invite as the kind without a radius use branch.delete, as control's
  own tests do now. The kind fixture loses review.*.
